python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Data for convertible foreign currencies (in millions of dollars) for CY 1963-1977
data = [212, 432, 781, 1321, 2345, 3528, 2781, 629, 276, 241, 8, 5, 80, 320, 18]

n = len(data)
print(f"Data points: {n}")
print(f"Data: {data}")

# Calculate sample mean
mean = sum(data) / n
print(f"\nMean: {mean}")

# Calculate sample standard deviation (using n-1 denominator)
variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in data) / (n - 1)
std_dev = math.sqrt(variance)
print(f"Sample standard deviation: {std_dev}")

# Calculate Fisher-Pearson adjusted skewness
# g1 = (n / ((n-1)*(n-2))) * sum((xi - x_mean)^3 / s^3)
# Or equivalently: g1 = (n / ((n-1)*(n-2))) * sum(((xi - x_mean) / s)^3)

numerator_sum = sum(((x - mean) / std_dev) ** 3 for x in data)
coefficient = n / ((n - 1) * (n - 2))

skewness = coefficient * numerator_sum

print(f"\nCoefficient (n/((n-1)*(n-2))): {coefficient}")
print(f"Sum of cubed z-scores: {numerator_sum}")
print(f"\nFisher-Pearson adjusted skewness: {skewness}")
print(f"Rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(skewness, 3)}")
EOF
